part: A: the Endless Night to Niko's second rope game

switches.why: the island tag's switch (TagIsl 0x05FF1903 in sea room 23: swbit 0x19), daTag_Island_c::actionReady (d_a_tag_island.cpp:399-406)

restart.evidence: saving on an island after RODE_KORL restarts at the ground's restart number, 0 on the disc (dComIfGs_setGameStartStage, checkIsland)

evidence: TagIsl type 3 in sea room 23 (Greatfish Isle), parameters 0x05FF1903: event 5 ARRIVAL_BRK, switch 0x19; getArrivalFlag type 3 = ENDLESS_NIGHT (d_a_tag_island.cpp:82-92), set by demoInitProc (:133-135)

dKy_checkEventNightStop: ENDLESS_NIGHT without Nayru's Pearl (d_kankyo.cpp:3161-3167); while it holds the time stays at night (d_kankyo.cpp:478-479) and Windfall uses layers 2|3 (getLayerNo; the stage select names Windfall's layer 3 'pirates')

steps.label: Windfall in the Endless Night: the pirates in town

switches.why: the island tag's switch (TagIsl 0x1CFF5B04 on Windfall's layers 2 and 3: swbit 0x5B), daTag_Island_c::actionReady

evidence: TagIsl type 4 on Windfall's layers 2 and 3 (SCO2, SCO3), parameters 0x1CFF5B04: event 0x1C ARRIVAL_TWN, switch 0x5B; getArrivalFlag type 4 = 0x1F04, and arrivalTerms requires dKy_checkEventNightStop (d_a_tag_island.cpp:116-120)
the King's hints: with 0x1F04 and without 0x2110 message 0x621 (see what the pirates are doing), d_a_ship.cpp:519-522; message 0x622 sets 0x1F01 (:650-651), never on in the catalog

steps.label: The pirates' password, overheard in the bomb shop
evidence: TagEv type 9 in the bomb shop (Obombh room 0, SCOB, parameters 0x00FF1009): its start sets 0x3B20 if off and picks the password into event register 0xBA0F (daTag_Event_c, d_a_tag_event.cpp:108-120); its end sets 0x2110 (:145-146); bombshop.stb sets 0x2110 too (the decomp's note in d_save_event_flag.inc; d_a_demo00.cpp:670)
Tetra and the pirates (Zl1, P1a, P1b, P1c) stand in the bomb shop on both its layers
catalog: 0x2110 and 0x3B20 off in 15, on in 16; register 0xBA0F 0 -> 1
steps.notes: 0x3B20 can come earlier, from talking to the password door before the cutscene (daKnob00_c::actionPassward2, d_a_knob00.cpp:609-611), which also picks the password. The register 0xBA0F (0-5, random) is not checked here.

steps.label: The password entered at the pirate ship's door
evidence: the pirate ship on Windfall's layers 2 and 3 (Pirates, parameters 0xFFFF0100, door byte 1) creates its deck door with parameters 0x101004FF, door type 4, the password door (daObj_Pirateship, d_a_obj_pirateship.cpp:214, 238, 253; dDoor_info_c::getType, d_door.cpp:26-28); Outset's pirate ship has door byte 0
the door stays locked without 0x1910 (d_a_knob00.cpp:710-714); the right password needs 0x2110 (chkPassward, :172) and sets 0x1910 (actionPassward2, :630-633)
catalog: off in 15, on in 16

unplaced.notes: Every flag that first turns on between catalog 15 and 16 outside the Forest Haven arc is placed here. Event registers not placed: 0xBA0F is the password number (0-5); 0x7B03 (LETTER_ORCA) and 0xB503 (LETTER_KOMALIS_FATHER) are letters; 0xAB03 (1 -> 3) and 0xCF03 (1 -> 3) were not identified.
